value.summary: This pull request updates several import paths by removing `openhuman::` from `openhuman_core` module paths. The changes are purely cosmetic — existing `openhuman::` segments that were moved or re-exported are collapsed. No dangerous sinks, untrusted input, new network/subprocess calls, deserialization of untrusted data, path traversal, secrets, or permission changes are introduced. The change is safe to merge.
